# FFPC fixtures

Captured 2026-10-13 from the founder's own signed-in browser (Claude in Chrome, read only). League: Big Gorilla Tourney (Aug 21 9:00 PM) #104870, ltuid F3C-781497793F8E, team "My Ball Zach Ertz", season 2026, week 6. Pages are the HTML of the main content with scripts, styles, images, hidden form fields and event attributes stripped and whitespace collapsed; ids, classes, hrefs and table attributes are kept. Session cookies: BGSLMSession and BGSLMAuthenticated (names only). The site also calls https://api.myffpc.com/api/ with a bearer token from its own JavaScript (myTeams.js); page URLs: /LeagueHome.aspx?ltuid=, /Standings.aspx, /Rosters.aspx, /leagueRulesFFPC.aspx, /DraftBoard.aspx, /Schedule.aspx, /Transactions.aspx, /MyTeams.aspx.

## Files (13)

ffpc-my-teams.html (/MyTeams.aspx: the member's leagues with record, points, place, last opponent and score), ffpc-league-home.html (/LeagueHome.aspx: team card, current and previous matchup, standings and schedule panels, scoreboard), ffpc-standings.html, ffpc-rosters.html (every team's roster), ffpc-rules.html (/leagueRulesFFPC.aspx: the scoring and roster rules), ffpc-draft-board.html (/DraftBoard.aspx: the board renders inside iframes, two with query-string ids and one blob; the outer page is captured, the board grid itself may need its iframe fetched by the extension), ffpc-draft-report.html (/DraftReportCard.aspx: the completed draft by pick), ffpc-schedule.html (/Schedule.aspx: every week's matchups and results), ffpc-transactions.html, ffpc-team-lineup.html (/SetLineup.aspx: the member's roster with lineup slots, the richest page), ffpc-scoreboard.html (/Scoreboard.aspx: live scoring for the week), ffpc-owners.html (team to owner names), ffpc-free-agents.html (/FreeAgents.aspx: the unrostered pool with stats). Every league page is a plain GET keyed by ltuid; the session cookies BGSLMSession and BGSLMAuthenticated authorise them. The "Export Team Data" button on My Teams calls https://api.myffpc.com/api/ with a bearer token minted by the site's own JavaScript (not captured; the extension may be able to use the same call from the page context).
